title: Garrison / Protocols (MCP, A2A, SSE)
description: MCP tools and sessions, A2A methods and task states, server-sent event streams, WebSockets, delegation, and synchronous invocation waits.

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant
list.description: Tenant ID. Empty until the first run is created.

list.name: tool
list.label: MCP tool
list.description: MCP tool; agent tools are reported as agent.

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.description: Garrison node: the server pod or container name, or the worker node name.

list.name: window
list.label: Average over
list.description: Window for rates, averages, and percentiles. Runs are infrequent, so short windows leave gaps.

panels.title: Tool calls
panels.description: MCP tool calls in the selected range.

panels.title: Tool errors
panels.description: MCP tool calls that ended in an error.

panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: MCP sessions served by the replicas.

panels.title: Sessions created
panels.description: MCP sessions created in the selected range.

panels.title: Sessions restored
panels.description: Sessions served on another replica than the one that created them.

panels.title: Open SSE streams
panels.description: Server-sent event streams open now.

panels.title: Tool calls by tool (per minute)
panels.description: MCP tool calls per minute, by tool.

targets.expr: sum by (tool) (rate(garrison_mcp_tool_calls_total{tool=~"$tool", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "tool", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Tool results by tool and result
panels.description: Tool outcomes.

targets.expr: sum by (tool, result) (increase(garrison_mcp_tool_results_total{tool=~"$tool"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "tool", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Tool call duration by tool
panels.description: MCP tool call duration, including the wait for invoked agents. Exemplar dots open the trace.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, tool) (rate(garrison_mcp_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{tool=~"$tool"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "tool", "none", "", "")
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tool) (rate(garrison_mcp_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{tool=~"$tool"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "tool", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Sessions by event
panels.description: MCP session lifecycle: created, restored, closed, expired.

panels.title: MCP endpoint latency (Voltaic)
panels.description: Voltaic's own MCP endpoint duration, 95th percentile by outcome.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, voltaic_outcome) (rate(voltaic_http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{node=~"$node"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "voltaic_outcome", "none", "", "")

panels.title: A2A requests by method and result (per minute)
panels.description: A2A JSON-RPC requests per minute.

targets.expr: sum by (method, result) (rate(garrison_a2a_requests_total[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "method", "none", "", "")

panels.title: A2A method duration
panels.description: A2A method duration by method, including blocking SendMessage waits.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, method) (rate(garrison_a2a_request_duration_seconds_bucket{}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "method", "none", "", "")
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method) (rate(garrison_a2a_request_duration_seconds_bucket{}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "method", "none", "", "")

panels.title: A2A task states
panels.description: Task states returned to callers.

panels.title: Open SSE streams by kind
panels.description: Run event streams and A2A streams open per replica.

panels.title: SSE events sent (per minute)
panels.description: Server-sent events written, by stream kind.

panels.title: WebSockets
panels.description: Live-update WebSocket sessions open and messages per minute.

panels.title: Delegation depth
panels.description: Call depth of delegated runs when created (median and 95th percentile), by calling agent.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_delegation_depth_bucket[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_delegation_depth_bucket[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Delegation denials by reason
panels.description: Delegations refused (depth, cycle, policy).

panels.title: cancelOnDisconnect cancels
panels.description: Runs cancelled because the waiting caller disconnected, by surface.

panels.title: Invocation waits by surface
panels.description: How long synchronous invocations waited (REST wait, MCP invoke, A2A SendMessage).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, surface) (rate(garrison_invocation_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "surface", "none", "", "")
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, surface) (rate(garrison_invocation_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "surface", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Invocation waits by result
panels.description: Waits that completed, timed out, disconnected, or were cancelled.

targets.expr: sum by (surface, result) (increase(garrison_invocation_wait_duration_seconds_count[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "surface", "none", "", "")

panels.title: MCP and A2A traces
panels.description: Recent MCP tool and A2A method spans.
